info.name: NextGen Catalog Accounts Extracted Text API
Get extracted text for a given naid and digital object ID.

params.name: naId
params.description: Unique, NARA-specific identifier given to each record.

params.name: objectId
params.description: Unique ID given to an object

params.name: page
params.description: Page number of the paginated result set in which to return.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results returned for each page of paginated data.

items.docs: Returns a list of extracted text for a given naid and digital object ID.
